Key architectural point
TaskForge Platform does not need to become a RAG database it uses it as a tool. Temporal owns durable orchestration; the Temporal Worker executes the Directed Acyclic Graphs's of agent activities; the agent uses the docling-rag API as an external capability. This keeps RAG replaceable and keeps workflow state/observability in TaskForge.

Why Temporal matters here
Each external RAG call is part of a durable TaskForge workflow rather than an ad-hoc HTTP request. If an agent/activity fails, the workflow can retry; if human approval is required, the workflow can pause and later resume. Temporal UI exposes the workflow history and state.
